findings.description: ADR 0164 states "The `landed` event is unchanged"; this diff adds `acceptedHead`/`pinned` to that event and cites decision 164 as the reason, but no ADR was amended.
findings.body:
**Code and ADR now disagree.** This PR adds `acceptedHead` and `pinned` to the `landed` payload on a moved-head land, and it cites decision 164 as the authority for doing so. The accepted ADR says the event does not change.

[`docs/adr/0164-pup-land-takes-a-moved-head-on-the-operator-s-word.md` L25-26](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/8dc7c8274f9237bdbf518fe0d42748c1f493757d/docs/adr/0164-pup-land-takes-a-moved-head-on-the-operator-s-word.md#L25-L26):

> The teardown deletes the branch when main or the accepted head holds it. The `landed` event is unchanged.

Where the PR conflicts with it:

- [`land.service.ts` L249-255](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/8dc7c8274f9237bdbf518fe0d42748c1f493757d/src/core/land.service.ts#L249-L255) writes `{ ...landed, acceptedHead: head, pinned: sha }` whenever `head !== sha`.
- The new JSDoc ([`session-event.types.ts` L38-47](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/8dc7c8274f9237bdbf518fe0d42748c1f493757d/src/core/types/session-event.types.ts#L38-L47)) cites "(decision 164)" for the new fields.
- The new test comment (`land.test.ts` L707) cites decision 164 too.

No ADR has `Amends: 0164`, and nothing under `docs/` mentions `acceptedHead`. AGENTS.md makes `docs/adr/` the record of resolved decisions.

**Cost:** a reader who follows either citation finds a decision that says the opposite of the code. A later change that brings the code back in line with 0164 would strip these fields as drift.

**Fix:** record the decision. `docs/adr/README.md` says a landed ADR is not rewritten in place, so either:

- append a dated amendment section to 0164, or
- add a new decision with `Amends: 0164`.

It should say the event records `acceptedHead` and `pinned` when a head past the pin is accepted. Then point the JSDoc and the test comment at that record. The code itself needs no change.

process_issues.description: The reviewer reported that the docs/conventions/*.md contents reached it only as @-references in .claude/rules/*.md, not as injected text. Its testing, naming and general checks therefore rest on comparison with sibling files, not on quoted rules.
